title: Suez: a connection can close
hook: Does opening a canal make its connection permanent?

frames.heading: Construction
frames.text: Digging begins near today’s Port Said.

frames.heading: Opening
frames.text: The canal opens between two seas.

reveal: The physical channel was not a permanently available connection. After opening in 1869, Suez closed following the 1967 war and reopened in 1975. Maps of infrastructure need time as well as geometry: a line on a map does not guarantee an open route. Construction also depended on Egyptian labor under harsh conditions.
limit: Canal geometry is schematic; the closed frame shows interruption, not disappearance.
